origin: Built-in image_gen, adapting the user's attached topographic background; two original theme-specific texture plates, not an inverted image.

prompts.dark: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: fixed mobile app background ONLY, no UI. Input image: the attached charcoal topographic image is the reference and edit target. Preserve its organic flowing contour-line language and understated material; create a PORTRAIT background suitable for a tall phone. Warm deep charcoal base close to #151315, exceptionally subtle fine matte paper grain. Hairline topographic contours in very muted brown/copper charcoal close to #302725, only a small tonal step above the ground. Keep a large calm field in the upper-left where the app title will sit, with delicate contours mostly toward upper-right and lower portions. Soft natural irregular curves, no mechanical repeated arcs. The linework must be barely visible and remain subordinate to foreground UI. Flat even material, no illumination or strong gradient. No text, typography, icons, gear, controls, cards, landscape photography, people, objects, neon, glowing edges, light streaks, shadows, gloss, glass or tiling seams. This is the actual texture plate, not a phone mockup. Opaque background.
